name: Dotnet Suite
description: Grants the agents dotnet CLI capability through an allowlist, plus protections for sensitive .NET config files.

allowedCommands.label: Allowed Dotnet Subcommands
allowedCommands.description: Comma-separated list of dotnet subcommands the agents may run. Entries may be multi-word (e.g. 'tool install', 'tool uninstall') — each entry matches the full token after 'dotnet '. See the keyword table below for each available subcommand. Default empty string means no dotnet commands allowed.
